name: project-dashboard
description: Side pane for Claude Code: this session's dev servers (click to open), the repo's markdown docs, and the backlog-delivery PBI board. Folds persist.

docOpener.title: Doc opener
docOpener.description: Command that opens a markdown file; the path is appended. For example xdg-open, code, or your own script.

browserOpener.title: Browser opener
browserOpener.description: Command that opens a dev server URL; the URL is appended.

launchPrefix.title: Launch prefix
launchPrefix.description: Optional wrapper placed before the opener, for example 'uwsm-app --' on Omarchy or Hyprland with uwsm.

moveToWorkspace.title: Open docs on this workspace
moveToWorkspace.description: Hyprland only: move the window a doc opens in onto the workspace of the focused terminal. Needs hyprctl and jq.
